svg.desc: Synthetic final-results figure with two horizontal panels. Left: zero-baseline bars compare mean task success with sample SD error bars across six runs per method. Baseline is about 57.9 percent, Context 69.5 percent and Proposed 79.0 percent. Right: eighteen unconnected points show all six seed-labeled runs per method on a 50 to 85 percent scale. Baseline gray circles range from 56.337 to 58.904 percent, Context orange triangles from 67.671 to 71.353 percent, and Proposed blue squares from 77.382 to 80.181 percent. A three-marker legend identifies methods. Proposed has the highest mean in these Synthetic data.
svg.title: Synthetic final results and run variation
